first.rationale: Verify onboarding because it directly addresses the current completion and activation declines, and verify promotional pricing because it is the strongest competing response but may trade acquisition lift for weaker long-term customer quality or margins. Pending verification, simplifying onboarding is the better fit for sustainable qualified revenue; pricing remains plausible but carries unresolved downstream-value risk.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding. The verified source shows higher completion, faster time-to-value, and improved 30-day retention, directly addressing both current declines while supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Promotional pricing is rejected despite acquisition lift because its verified cohort suffered a 12% retention decline and did not survive the first renewal cycle. A controlled experiment preserves uncertainty about whether the earlier onboarding result generalizes to the current population.
